title: scct.map-changes versions 1-3
description: An RE+ Map JSON change file (docs/MapAuthoring.md, scct://docs/map-authoring), applied by View > Import Map from JSON..., the bridge op authoring.apply and map_changes_apply. Version 1: create, component, update, link. Version 2 adds load, texture, save, surface, polygon brushes and map "*". Version 3 adds delete with allowDeletes. Unknown fields are rejected everywhere. Every property leaf is a string: numbers "64", bools "True"/"False", enums bare, text JSON-quoted ("\"Door\""), structs complete, object references {"$ref": id} or an exported path. Map changes apply in one Undo step: deletes, creates, components, properties, links; package loads, imports and saves run first and cannot be undone. The editor's own checks (live class schema, exported before values, package rules) go further than this schema.

version.description: 3 is the latest; version 1 and 2 files keep working unchanged.

map.description: The destination map exactly as exported (snapshot.map / authoring.mapid), or "*" for the map that is open (version 2 and later, not with deletes).

expect.description: Exported values of existing objects a link or component touches, keyed by exact object path; stale links and attachments are refused.

allowDeletes.description: Version 3 only: required (true) for a file that deletes actors.

operations.description: At most 2,000 operations in version 1 and 20,000 in versions 2 and 3.

id.description: A creation id: up to 63 letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit; unique in the file ignoring case. The new actor's Tag defaults to it.

path.description: Exported object path, such as MyLevel.Light12.

value.description: A property value: a string leaf, a struct (object of values; every field), an array of values, or {"$ref": id-or-path}.

vertices.description: 3-16 points local to the brush's Location, in the editor's brush-face winding; split larger faces.

create.description: Create an actor of a loaded class. Location is mandatory; omitted properties keep native class defaults. geometry point (default) for ordinary actors; box (always a 256 uu cube) or polygons (version 2) for brush classes.

component.description: A particle-emitter component appended to its owner's Emitters (do not also replace Emitters in the same file).

owner.description: A creation id in this file or an existing emitter's exported path (add it to expect).

update.description: Change an existing actor or component. before is its complete exported values; any change since export rejects the update. One update per object.

link.description: trigger true: set the target's Event to the SMagicEvent's Tag (the target triggers the event). trigger false: append an action aimed at the target's Tag to the event's group, after a delay.

event.description: The SMagicEvent: creation id or exported path.

group.description: Event group index (default 0); an event with no groups gets its first group.

delay.description: Seconds, 0-86400, as a string. Actions only (not with trigger true).

load.description: Version 2. Load a package by name: System\<name>.u, then Packages\Textures .utx, StaticMeshes .usx, Animations .ukx, Sounds .uax/.uas.

texture.description: Version 2. Import a texture: sides powers of two up to 8192 (4096 practical); the path is Package.Group.Name or Package.Name. Importing over an existing texture is rejected.

file.description: .bmp, .tga, .pcx or .dds; relative paths are relative to the change file's folder (baseDirectory).

format.description: Default DXT1; DXT5 for alpha. Omit for .dds, which keeps its own format and mips.

mips.description: Default true: the whole mip chain.

save.description: Version 2. Save Packages\Textures\<package>.utx; only a package an earlier load or texture operation in this file names. overwrite replaces an existing file (backed up first).

surface.description: Version 2. Apply a material to BSP surfaces by index of the current BSP (rebuild geometry first).

delete.description: Version 3. Delete one exported actor (at most 1,000 per file). before must equal its current values exactly. LevelInfo, the builder brush, cameras and particle components are never deleted; a deleted actor cannot be updated, linked, given a component or referenced in the same file.
